pageLede: A short verification unlocks your Coursera license, giving you free access to unlimited courses and certificates through Kiron and Coursera.
sponsorCallout: Offered through Kiron. If eligible, you'll receive a free Coursera license — usually within 3 working days of submitting.
whyWeAskP1: The access to courses available from Coursera for Impact is reserved for refugees, asylum seekers and people under international protection. We collect the information indicated below solely for the purpose of checking your eligibility. Your details are stored securely.
whyWeAskP2: To attend a Coursera course you will be redirected to Coursera's platform, where Coursera's privacy policy and terms of usage apply.
statusHint: Choose the status that best describes you.
originLockedHint: Taken from your profile — edit it there if it isn't correct.
step2Lede: Please enter the information exactly as it appears on your official document. Kiron may request the document later as part of a random sample check.
namePlaceholder: exactly as written on your document
personalHelpText: Use the spelling exactly as it appears on your official document.
docTypeHint: If your document isn't in the list, write to

docNumHelp: For your privacy, only enter the last 6 digits of the number printed on the front of your document.

docGuideShowItem0: A mention of your status — refugee, asylum seeker or another form of international protection (e.g. subsidiary or temporary protection)
docGuideShowItem3: An expiration date, if your document has one
docGuideIntroIssuedBy: The document can be issued by:
docGuideIssuedBy0: An international organisation — UNHCR, IOM, UNRWA or similar
docGuideIssuedBy1: The government of the country you live in, or where you claimed asylum
docGuideSpecialRounds: Some verification rounds reserve spots for learners from one specific country based on Kiron's activities — for those rounds we can also accept a passport, national ID or similar national documentation. Eligible learners are informed by email beforehand.
docGuideFindNumber: Where to find the number: the document or serial number is usually printed on the front of the card or document. Only the last 6 digits are needed. See the
